dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shapes exhibit soft-edged, low-contrast gradients transitioning from the dark charcoal exterior to light grey interiors. The perimeters are jagged and non-uniform.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, solid light-grey pixel clusters located between the larger ring structures, specifically concentrated along the mid-lateral transition zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest rings on the mid-left flank form an elongated scalene triangle, while a secondary cluster of four smaller annuli forms a roughly linear chain leading toward the posterior flipper.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive and highly complex network of interconnected ring-like structures forming a continuous, map-like texture over the majority of the visible dorsal surface.
